title: Task
description: One task, as `.ai/tasks/TASK-NNN-<slug>.md` or as an inline entity block in `.ai/TASKS.md`. Rule 3 of CONTEXT_SPEC 3 requires `acceptance` with at least one entry, and makes `waived: true` the only way to run without one: an `IN_PROGRESS` task with nothing to be done by is CTX-009, and that is a finding about the process rather than about the schema.

status.description: Legal transitions are CONTEXT_SPEC 3 and are reported by `doctor` as CTX-011. This schema can see only the current value, so it deliberately does not pretend to check the history behind it.

depends_on.description: Acyclic by rule; a cycle is CTX-010, which needs the whole graph and so belongs to `doctor`, not here.

spec.description: A `SPEC-<slug>` entity, or a path to a normative document under `docs/`. An unresolvable value is CTX-007.

touches.description: Path globs this task is allowed to write. An unresolved glob is a warning, not an error.

acceptance.description: What must be true for this task to be done. At least one, unless `waived` is true.

waived.description: Set only with a written reason, and only for a task whose acceptance cannot be written down yet.

done.description: What was actually built and verified, recorded when the task closed. Not acceptance criteria restated: this is the evidence.
